```{r, echo=FALSE}
reptravail<-"D:/"

  ad_GSE<-"/R2 CUBE+/R2 OUT/"
GSE<-"GSE+.Rda"#Test_ReO.V1.Rda"
pas_t<-0.5 # pas du GSE

# params
N<-dim(cube_placement[,,])[1]
Tmp<-dim(cube_placement[,,])[2]
NbAct<-dim(cube_placement[,,])[3]

# Chargement des fonctions utilis?es: cumul des rendements
source(paste(reptravail,"/R1 CUBE++/R1 Fonctions locale/F_Rdtcumul3D.R",sep=""))
```

## Deflator

The deflator calculation is based on the short rate Rt

```{r fig1, fig.height = 5, fig.width = 5, fig.align = "center", echo=FALSE}

nb_tr=1 #deflator nb

x<-1:length(cube_placement[1,,nb_tr])
max<-apply(cube_placement[,,nb_tr],MARGIN=2,FUN=quantile,probs=0.997)
min<-apply(cube_placement[,,nb_tr],MARGIN=2,FUN=quantile,probs=0.003)
qet2max<-apply(cube_placement[,,nb_tr],MARGIN=2,FUN=quantile,probs=0.954)
qet2min<-apply(cube_placement[,,nb_tr],MARGIN=2,FUN=quantile,probs=0.046)
qetmax<-apply(cube_placement[,,nb_tr],MARGIN=2,FUN=quantile,probs=0.683)
qetmin<-apply(cube_placement[,,nb_tr],MARGIN=2,FUN=quantile,probs=0.317)
#mean<-apply(cube[,,nb_tr],MARGIN=2,FUN=quantile,probs=0.5)
mean<-apply(cube_placement[,,nb_tr],MARGIN=2,FUN=mean)

# trac? non-cumul?
plot(NULL,NULL,xlim=c(min(x),max(x)),ylim=c(min(min),max(max)),
         xlab="time",ylab="Rate",main="Deflator")
polygon(x=c(x,rev(x)),y=c(max,rev(min)),col="grey",border=NA)
polygon(x=c(x,rev(x)),y=c(qet2max,rev(qet2min)),col="lightblue",border=NA)
polygon(x=c(x,rev(x)),y=c(qetmax,rev(qetmin)),col="blue",border=NA)
lines(x,mean,type="l",col="red")
legend("topleft", inset=.01, title="Qantiles",
       c(expression(3*sigma),expression(2*sigma),expression(sigma),"av."), fill=c("grey","lightblue","blue","red"), horiz=TRUE, cex=0.6)
```


## Inflation, Equity, Property

Modelized equity protfolio presents 3 different out sets called slices.
One is the total return and the two others are decomposition between dividends and capital change (without div.)

```{r fig3, echo=FALSE}
par(mfrow = c(2,3))
nb_tr=c(2,3,4)
for (i in 1:length(nb_tr)){
  
x<-1:length(cube_placement[1,,nb_tr[i]])
max<-apply(cube_placement[,,nb_tr[i]],MARGIN=2,FUN=quantile,probs=0.997)
min<-apply(cube_placement[,,nb_tr[i]],MARGIN=2,FUN=quantile,probs=0.003)
qet2max<-apply(cube_placement[,,nb_tr[i]],MARGIN=2,FUN=quantile,probs=0.954)
qet2min<-apply(cube_placement[,,nb_tr[i]],MARGIN=2,FUN=quantile,probs=0.046)
qetmax<-apply(cube_placement[,,nb_tr[i]],MARGIN=2,FUN=quantile,probs=0.683)
qetmin<-apply(cube_placement[,,nb_tr[i]],MARGIN=2,FUN=quantile,probs=0.317)
#mean<-apply(cube_placement[,,nb_tr],MARGIN=2,FUN=quantile,probs=0.5)
mean<-apply(cube_placement[,,nb_tr[i]],MARGIN=2,FUN=mean)
# trac? non-cumul?
plot(NULL,NULL,xlim=c(min(x),max(x)),ylim=c(min(min),max(max)),
         xlab="time",ylab="rates",main=paste("Quantiles of ","\n",sep=""),cex.main=0.8)
polygon(x=c(x,rev(x)),y=c(max,rev(min)),col="grey",border=NA)
polygon(x=c(x,rev(x)),y=c(qet2max,rev(qet2min)),col="lightblue",border=NA)
polygon(x=c(x,rev(x)),y=c(qetmax,rev(qetmin)),col="blue",border=NA)
lines(x,mean,type="l",col="red")
legend("topleft", inset=.01, title="Qantiles",
       c(expression(3*sigma),expression(2*sigma),expression(sigma),"av."), fill=c("grey","lightblue","blue","red"), horiz=TRUE, cex=0.4)

}

for (i in 1:length(nb_tr)){

#trace pour la tranche
x<-1:length(CumulESGDefl[1,,nb_tr[i]])
max<-apply(CumulESGDefl[,,nb_tr[i]],MARGIN=2,FUN=quantile,probs=0.997)
min<-apply(CumulESGDefl[,,nb_tr[i]],MARGIN=2,FUN=quantile,probs=0.003)
qet2max<-apply(CumulESGDefl[,,nb_tr[i]],MARGIN=2,FUN=quantile,probs=0.954)
qet2min<-apply(CumulESGDefl[,,nb_tr[i]],MARGIN=2,FUN=quantile,probs=0.046)
qetmax<-apply(CumulESGDefl[,,nb_tr[i]],MARGIN=2,FUN=quantile,probs=0.683)
qetmin<-apply(CumulESGDefl[,,nb_tr[i]],MARGIN=2,FUN=quantile,probs=0.317)

# mean<-apply(CumulESGDefl[,,nb_tr],MARGIN=2,FUN=quantile,probs=0.5)
mean<-apply(CumulESGDefl[,,nb_tr[i]],MARGIN=2,FUN=mean)

# trac
plot(NULL,NULL,xlim=c(min(x),max(x)),ylim=c(0.5,5),
     xlab="time",ylab="rates",main=paste("deflated aggregate returns ","\n",sep=""),cex.main=0.8)
polygon(x=c(x,rev(x)),y=c(max,rev(min)),col="grey",border=NA)
polygon(x=c(x,rev(x)),y=c(qet2max,rev(qet2min)),col="lightblue",border=NA)
polygon(x=c(x,rev(x)),y=c(qetmax,rev(qetmin)),col="blue",border=NA)
lines(x,mean,type="l",col="red")
legend("topleft", inset=.01, title="Qantiles",
       c(expression(3*sigma),expression(2*sigma),expression(sigma),"av."), fill=c("grey","lightblue","blue","red"), horiz=TRUE, cex=0.4)
}
```
The total return must stay equal to 1 when cumulated total return is multiplied by deflator

Equity total return must be compared to the price of Deflator according to the standard deviation of the deflator
Equity total return must stay in between limits:
$$ 1 + \frac{q(\frac{x}{2})*SD}{\sqrt{N}}   and   1 + \frac{q(\frac{1-x}{2})*SD}{\sqrt{N}} $$

then for x = 0.02 (validation limit), and EIOPA curve for time step = 0.5

```{r fig4, fig.height = 5, fig.width = 5, fig.align = "center", echo=FALSE}
nb_tr=47
par(mfrow = c(1,2), mar = c(0,0,0,0))
norm_inv=2.32634787 #loi normale inverse pour proba de 1%

SD<-apply(CumulESGDefl[,,nb_tr],2,sd)
D<-apply(CumulESGDefl[,,nb_tr],2,mean)
Av_return<-rep(1,length(D))

plot(Av_return,type='l',ylim = c(0.9,1.1), cex = 1.5,col="blue", lty=2, lwd=2, main="Quality test on Property")
line_up<-(Av_return+(-norm_inv)*SD/(N^0.5))
lines(line_up, lwd=1)
line_down<-(Av_return+norm_inv*SD/(N^0.5))
lines(line_down, lwd=1)

lines(D,col='red',cex=3, lwd=2)
legend("topright", inset=.02, title="Property martingality)",
       c("Av. Total return","Expect. av. tot return","Stat. tolerances"), fill=c("red","blue","black"), horiz=TRUE, cex=0.6)
```

## Property

Modelized property presente 3 differents out sets called slices.
One is the total return and the two others are decomposition between rents returns and capital change (without rents)


## correlation
```{r fig8, echo=FALSE}
list_assets<-c(1,2,46,47,48)
precision<-100
mat_cor<-array(0,dim=c(length(list_assets),length(list_assets)))
for (i in 1:precision){
  mat_cor<-cor(cube_placement[i,,list_assets])+mat_cor
}
mat_cor<-mat_cor/precision
List_affichage<-ListNomActifs[list_assets]
cat(List_affichage)
print(mat_cor)
```
